summary: GoPro filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a securities purchase agreement with affiliates of CEO Nicholas Woodman. The buyers agreed to purchase $20 million in senior secured notes and warrants for approximately 25.7 million Class B common shares. The notes bear 6.50% interest payable-in-kind, mature July 2028, and are redeemable at par. Closing requires a waiver under GoPro's revolving credit agreement. This is a related-party financing with insider warrants, not a transformative event. Watch for shareholder approval requirements or potential overhang from warrant exercise.
